root_cause: The canonical rendered YC FileX had WTHER=M. Setting Gym-DSSAT random_weather=true and injecting rseed1 did not enable WGEN while FileX remained in measured-weather mode.
scope: Task-local runtime template copy only; canonical inputs, installed runtime, DSSAT binary, CNYC.CLI, PPO, reward, action, observation, and constraints are unchanged.
template_strategy: Copy each generated YC FileX template into results/yc_random_weather_ppo/004_03/runtime_templates and set every treatment METHODS.WTHER field to W without editing its source template.
weather_seed_strategy: Inject the scheduled weather seed before PDI runtime launch, then set the sequence adapter before every episode reset. Reuse the environment process only after the same-year smoke proved distinct daily weather sequences.
weather_diversity_evidence: Hash DSSAT daily state RAIN, SRAD, TMAX, and TMIN via the existing 003_06_05_02 weather capture helpers; do not hash the measured input WTH file as a proxy for generated weather.
prior_attempts: The earlier six-model run used WTHER=M and is retained as unverified history; its metrics are excluded from the corrected analysis.
